# gitmoap_ai_profile_draft (Data Source)

A persona draft, and once it is written, the persona. Only the person who asked for the draft can read it.

The token needs `ai_org:manage`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `draft_id` (String) The persona draft

### Read-Only

- `brief` (String) What the agent is for, in the person's words: 3 to 500 characters
- `completed_at` (String) When it was finished.
- `cost_micros` (Number) What it cost, fee included, in micro-dollars.
- `created_at` (String) When it was asked for.
- `failure` (String) Why a draft was not written.
- `instruction` (String) What the agent is for, in the person's words: 3 to 500 characters
- `model_id` (String)
- `org_id` (String)
- `persona` (String)
- `position` (String) An agent's job, which decides what it may do and which model tier it uses by default.
- `refines` (String) A persona draft: a persona a small model wrote from a person's brief
- `repositories` (Attributes List) The repositories it reads. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repositories))
- `sources` (Attributes List) The files the persona drew on. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sources))
- `state` (String) Where a draft stands: `queued` → `running` → `ready` or `failed`.
- `summary` (String) What the drafted agent does, in one line of at most 280 characters
- `written_for` (String) An agent's job, which decides what it may do and which model tier it uses by default.

<a id="nestedatt--repositories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repositories`

Read-Only:

- `full_path` (String) Its path as addresses name it, as it is now.
- `repository_id` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sources`

Read-Only:

- `path` (String)
- `repository_id` (String)
